note: MA DCR state park in East Taunton: 1,200 wooded acres with six lakes and ponds and a cranberry bog. Electric-and-water sites are in Loops A and B; Loops C and D are non-electric with some tent-only sites, and there is a generator-free area. Campers-only swimming at Middle Pond and a canoe/kayak launch on Lake Rico. Reopened in 2018 after a major renovation. --Claude
